body:
This works:
```
#...
quarkus.log.file.enable=true
quarkus.log.file.path=quarkus.log
```
If you really want a named handler you need to use a proper category, like `org.acme` in your case:
```
#...
quarkus.log.handler.file."CONSOLE_MIRROR".enable=true
quarkus.log.handler.file."CONSOLE_MIRROR".path=quarkus.log

quarkus.log.category."org.acme".handlers=CONSOLE_MIRROR
```

https://quarkus.io/guides/logging does not mention `""` to be a valid category.
So I'm inclined to close this. WDYT @dmlloyd?

In my understanding it was the way to declare the root category. Also It was working before quarkus 1.13.4 ( I upgraded directly from 1.12) so I assume something has changed recently.

My use case is that I need multiple log files attached to the root category with different format.

This seems like a legitimate request to me.  We should have a way to attach named handlers to the root logging config, like this:

```properties
quarkus.log.handler.file.CONSOLE_MIRROR.enable=true
quarkus.log.handler.file.CONSOLE_MIRROR.path=quarkus.log

quarkus.log.handlers=CONSOLE_MIRROR
```

This would be consistent with how we configure the root category log level.

Makes sense!

FWIW, something in [1.3.0.CR1](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/releases/tag/1.13.0.CR1) causes `quarkus.log.category."".handlers=CONSOLE_MIRROR` to not work as in 1.12.2.Final (just verified with this reproducer).
Maybe https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/88172b7f54030f536361c9f1e113c4539e1d10e6 or https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/5b69ffa9ded999138edfaaa6d9692bbf9697ee4a.

After some more investigation, even with a category set, the file handler does not work if the console is disabled.

This does not produce log in quarkus.log:
```
quarkus.log.console.enable=false

quarkus.log.handler.file."CONSOLE_MIRROR".enable=true
quarkus.log.handler.file."CONSOLE_MIRROR".path=quarkus.log

quarkus.log.category."org.acme".handlers=CONSOLE_MIRROR
```

This produce log in quarkus.log:
```
quarkus.log.console.enable=true

quarkus.log.handler.file."CONSOLE_MIRROR".enable=true
quarkus.log.handler.file."CONSOLE_MIRROR".path=quarkus.log

quarkus.log.category."org.acme".handlers=CONSOLE_MIRROR
```

If a file logger is configured, then everything work fine.
This produce log in quarkus.log:
```
quarkus.log.console.enable=false

quarkus.log.file.enable=true
quarkus.log.file.path=quarkus2.log
quarkus.log.handler.file."CONSOLE_MIRROR".enable=true
quarkus.log.handler.file."CONSOLE_MIRROR".path=quarkus.log

quarkus.log.category."org.acme".handlers=CONSOLE_MIRROR

```

issue.title: Add the ability to add custom log handlers to the root logger
